row.name: AppFolio Inc. Class A Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=33 breakdowns=1 bursts_in_base=2 giveback=0.5 tightness=0.85 base_volume_vs_leg=0.8 base_volume_vs_avg=0.93
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 33 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; the base gave back 0.5 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 9.3% vs its 20-SMA, 8.5% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 3 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: Three recorded check failures — C (33-session base, giveback 0.5, two bursts inside), RE (burst bar only 67% of the prior 5-bar range), and VOL (volume rank 23 of 60, only 1.09x the 50-session average when 1.5x is required for a base this long) — combine to make this a materially degraded setup. The base shaded on the chart is visibly wide and choppy, spanning from roughly $190 to $237 with multiple overlapping red and green bars and two prior burst attempts that failed to follow through, confirming the C FAIL. The signal bar itself is honest (close near high, gap only 0.5%), but the lack of range expansion and weak volume undercut conviction.
claude.key_risk: The 33-session base gave back half the prior leg gain and contains two failed bursts, meaning sellers have already tested this level twice and volume on the breakout is insufficient to overpower them.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the signal day's close of $223.70 or if volume in the first 30 minutes is tracking below the prior session's pace, confirming the weak-volume concern.
